p.src: 1  I am a rose of Sharon, a lily of the valleys.

en: I am a rose of Sharon, a lily of the valleys.
u.src: 1  I am a rose of Sharon, a lily of the valleys.

p.src: 2  As a lily among thorns, so is my love among the daughters.

en: As a lily among thorns, so is my love among the daughters.
u.src: 2  As a lily among thorns, so is my love among the daughters.

p.src: 3  As the apple tree among the trees of the wood, so is my beloved among the sons. I sat down under his shadow with great delight, his fruit was sweet to my taste.

en: As the apple tree among the trees of the wood, so is my beloved among the sons. I sat down under his shadow with great delight, his fruit was sweet to my taste.
u.src: 3  As the apple tree among the trees of the wood, so is my beloved among the sons. I sat down under his shadow with great delight, his fruit was sweet to my taste.

p.src: 4  He brought me to the banquet hall. His banner over me is love.

en: He brought me to the banquet hall. His banner over me is love.
u.src: 4  He brought me to the banquet hall. His banner over me is love.

p.src: 5  Strengthen me with raisins, refresh me with apples; for I am faint with love.

en: Strengthen me with raisins, refresh me with apples; for I am faint with love.
u.src: 5  Strengthen me with raisins, refresh me with apples; for I am faint with love.

p.src: 6  His left hand is under my head. His right hand embraces me.

en: His left hand is under my head. His right hand embraces me.
u.src: 6  His left hand is under my head. His right hand embraces me.

p.src: 7  I adjure you, daughters of Jerusalem, by the roes, or by the hinds of the field, that you not stir up, nor awaken love, until it so desires.

en: I adjure you, daughters of Jerusalem, by the roes, or by the hinds of the field, that you not stir up, nor awaken love, until it so desires.
u.src: 7  I adjure you, daughters of Jerusalem, by the roes, or by the hinds of the field, that you not stir up, nor awaken love, until it so desires.

p.src: 8  The voice of my beloved! Behold, he comes, leaping on the mountains, skipping on the hills.

en: The voice of my beloved! Behold, he comes, leaping on the mountains, skipping on the hills.
u.src: 8  The voice of my beloved! Behold, he comes, leaping on the mountains, skipping on the hills.

p.src: 9  My beloved is like a roe or a young deer. Behold, he stands behind our wall! He looks in at the windows. He glances through the lattice.

en: My beloved is like a roe or a young deer. Behold, he stands behind our wall! He looks in at the windows. He glances through the lattice.
u.src: 9  My beloved is like a roe or a young deer. Behold, he stands behind our wall! He looks in at the windows. He glances through the lattice.

p.src: 10  My beloved spoke, and said to me, “Rise up, my love, my beautiful one, and come away.

en: My beloved spoke, and said to me, “Rise up, my love, my beautiful one, and come away.
u.src: 10  My beloved spoke, and said to me, “Rise up, my love, my beautiful one, and come away.

p.src: 11  For behold, the winter is past. The rain is over and gone.

en: For behold, the winter is past. The rain is over and gone.
u.src: 11  For behold, the winter is past. The rain is over and gone.

p.src: 12  The flowers appear on the earth. The time of the singing has come, and the voice of the turtledove is heard in our land.

en: The flowers appear on the earth. The time of the singing has come, and the voice of the turtledove is heard in our land.
u.src: 12  The flowers appear on the earth. The time of the singing has come, and the voice of the turtledove is heard in our land.

p.src: 13  The fig tree ripens her green figs. The vines are in blossom. They give out their fragrance. Arise, my love, my beautiful one, and come away.”

en: The fig tree ripens her green figs. The vines are in blossom. They give out their fragrance. Arise, my love, my beautiful one, and come away.”
u.src: 13  The fig tree ripens her green figs. The vines are in blossom. They give out their fragrance. Arise, my love, my beautiful one, and come away.”

p.src: 14  My dove in the clefts of the rock, in the hiding places of the mountainside, let me see your face. Let me hear your voice; for your voice is sweet and your face is lovely.

en: My dove in the clefts of the rock, in the hiding places of the mountainside, let me see your face. Let me hear your voice; for your voice is sweet and your face is lovely.
u.src: 14  My dove in the clefts of the rock, in the hiding places of the mountainside, let me see your face. Let me hear your voice; for your voice is sweet and your face is lovely.

p.src: 15  Catch for us the foxes, the little foxes that plunder the vineyards; for our vineyards are in blossom.

en: Catch for us the foxes, the little foxes that plunder the vineyards; for our vineyards are in blossom.
u.src: 15  Catch for us the foxes, the little foxes that plunder the vineyards; for our vineyards are in blossom.

p.src: 16  My beloved is mine, and I am his. He browses among the lilies.

en: My beloved is mine, and I am his. He browses among the lilies.
u.src: 16  My beloved is mine, and I am his. He browses among the lilies.

p.src: 17  Until the day is cool, and the shadows flee away, turn, my beloved, and be like a roe or a young deer on the mountains of Bether.

en: Until the day is cool, and the shadows flee away, turn, my beloved, and be like a roe or a young deer on the mountains of Bether.
u.src: 17  Until the day is cool, and the shadows flee away, turn, my beloved, and be like a roe or a young deer on the mountains of Bether.
